wisp: 15% of hits: a ghost wisp strikes again for 80%

New: **Armor and Ward**: every monster wears Heavy Armor, Spirit, Hide or Flesh, shown on the target frame, the Map and the Monster Book
**Armor Pierce** and **Ward Pierce** from gear, buffs, your weapon, the **Breach** keystone branch and two new **pierce runes**, at most 50% (60% with the Breach keystone)
Knight and Monk skills leave **Armor Cracked**: +20% pierce on that monster for 6 s
**Armor tab** in the Element Chart: the four armours, your pierce and its sources, and your target worked out step by step
**A new look** for every window and the HUD, with right-click menus everywhere
**Blood Moon Night** · every Saturday 20:00–22:00, Bangkok time
**Map events** · root rift, black thorns, poison fog, with a chest for everyone who helped
**Option Stone window**: a padlock on every row, each row's kind from its own list, the cost and the smith points in one strip, and a card of every row rerolled
**Work Orders** show what each order takes; the quest tracker shows the life-skill AUTO time left today; mining shows **+1** for every ore a strike knocks loose
**13 new costume sets** in the Gacha Machine
Changed: A critical hit now ignores half of the armour, not all of it
A monster 10 or more levels above you keeps its armour: it doesn't break, and only a tenth of your damage gets through
Monsters above your level hit as hard as their own level, harder still when they are more than 5 levels above you
A new target frame: the monster's portrait and level, a clear HP bar, and its armour as a bar of its own under the HP
The HUD starts at 75% size and lays itself out for your screen; move, resize or hide its pieces from Settings › Screen and chat › Edit HUD
Monster HP, armour, coins and the EXP curve are tuned for Season 2
Costly actions still ask for a second press
Balance: Job power tuned at Lv 55, 70 and 90
**Refining**: no step is sure any more (90% at best), a hot furnace stops at 95%, and each step costs more coins
**Option stones**: lock up to 3 rows and roll every other row at once, each to the kind you pick; each row locked takes one more stone and more coins
**Option stones, drill stones and tier-I runes** drop far less; a monster gives an option stone only within 10 levels of you
**Quench oil** 50 and **lamp oil** 13 (Work Orders ask for more bottles); the furnace takes 10% of a good's price; planks take 10 logs; an iron bar takes a copper ore too
**Mining**: every strike knocks loose its share of the vein's ore (all of it on the glint, 80% off it, half for AUTO); a vein gives none when it breaks
**Option stones** from chests 1.5%; bars and cut crystals take a little fewer per refine and their prices rise a little (fitted to the new mining)
**AUTO** life skills: 4 hours a day, and a tree AUTO fells gives half
**Silver trees** grow on the Northward Trail (Lv 60–72) as well as Shadowmist Lake
Fixed: The mines now open on the Season 2 build
Work Orders no longer ask for thousands of charcoal
Monster names are no longer cut short
Leftover Thai lines are in English now

body.p: Every monster now wears one of four armours. **Armor** takes from physical hits, **Ward** from magic.

ul: **Armor Pierce**: gear, buffs, spears, lances, bows, crossbows, pistols and rapiers (+10%)
**Ward Pierce**: gear, buffs, an epic or better staff, orb, book, lantern or bell (+10%)
The **Breach** keystone branch, **Armor Cracked** from Knight and Monk skills, and two pierce runes
At most **50%** in all, **60%** with the Breach keystone

body.p: Your totals are under **Status · Detailed Stats**. The target frame names a monster's armour; click the frame for its Armor and Ward right now.
This build opens as **Season 2** from the first screen, with every new system on.

ul: **A new look** for every window and the HUD

body.p: The full list is in the patch notes.
Every **Saturday 20:00–22:00** (Bangkok time) the moon turns red over every hunting map.

ul: Monsters have **HP and ATK ×1.25** and give **EXP ×1.25**
They come back after **10 s**, and each map holds half as many again
Pack leaders come **3× as often** and drop 3 of their materials and a potion, sometimes an Option Stone

body.p: Open **Today** from the News button to see how long is left.
Every **60 to 120 minutes** something happens on a hunting map, for **10 minutes**. AUTO can join in.
A rift tears open: five waves crawl out, then their captain.
Eight thorns sprout round the hero and keep growing. Cut them all.
Monsters inside hit **30% harder** and drop **twice the materials**. Break the three mist hearts.
Win: a **root chest** for everyone who helped. Lose: nothing is lost, but the roots hold the map for 10 minutes.
Season 2 runs **offline** in your browser for now.

ul: Each browser keeps its own save
Party, guild and market with real people come when it goes online

posts.title: Found a bug? Tell us on Discord

body.p: Open **Report Bug** from the menu (Esc). It takes you to our Discord.
